title: The Origin of Brainstorm
short_teaser: Brainstorm once referred to a sudden disturbance of the mind.
story: Brainstorm once referred to a sudden disturbance of the mind. In the twentieth century it became associated with generating many ideas without immediate criticism. A word can be repurposed when people need language for a new practice. Words shape what we notice and remember. Naming an experience can make it easier to understand, share, and use. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
